name: charly-punktfunk
description: Self-contained skills for the punktfunk streaming-host image family (CachyOS base): the punktfunk/1 QUIC host daemon, its browser console and its plugin runner, installed from unom's signed pacman repo with a headless Sway compositor for the host to drive.
